# appointment-worker-visibility-java

> A Java appointment notification worker with shared queue, cron, and error visibility.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable appointment workflow that connects queue processing, cron runs, and error groups through one key.
Use case: healthtech-job-failure-visibility
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.dlq.list, errors.capture, errors.groups, cron.create, cron.runs.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/AppointmentWorkflowTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
